Summary: Embedding generation and versioning
Description: Implement embedding generation: call OpenAI text-embedding-3-small (via adapter). Batch chunks (100 per call). Store embeddings in the embeddings table with model_version. Implement re-embedding when model version changes. Track embedding status per chunk.

Acceptance Criteria: 1. Embeddings generated for all chunks in a test document. 2. model_version stored with each embedding. 3. Batch calls used (not one-per-chunk). 4. Failed embedding calls are retried up to 3 times with backoff. 5. Unit test with mocked OpenAI adapter.

Summary: Hybrid keyword and semantic retrieval
Description: Implement hybrid search: PostgreSQL full-text search (tsvector/tsquery) for keyword, pgvector cosine similarity for semantic. Fuse results using Reciprocal Rank Fusion (RRF). Return top-k passages with scores. All results filtered by workspace_id from auth context.
Business Value: Hybrid search delivers better recall than either method alone — critical for diverse enterprise queries.
Acceptance Criteria: 1. Semantic-only query returns relevant chunks. 2. Keyword query catches exact-match terms that semantic misses. 3. Hybrid fusion returns better top-5 than either alone on test queries. 4. All results belong to the requesting workspace. 5. Unit tests for RRF fusion logic.
Technical Notes: Implement RRF: score = Σ 1/(k + rank_i) where k=60. workspace_id applied as a WHERE clause, not a post-filter. See .kiro/specs/project-01/spec.md.
Testing Requirements: Unit: RRF fusion, workspace isolation. Integration: full search pipeline against test DB. Security: workspace isolation test.
Security Requirements: Workspace_id enforced at DB query level.
Definition of Done: Hybrid search tested and workspace isolation verified. Human reviewer approved.
